title: Yummy Dense Chinese Chicken Buddha Jumps
description: A winey, dense chicken dish with toasted bread and cinnamon, served directly from a tagine pot for a romantic date night.
instructions: Preheat the tagine pot over medium heat and drizzle the sesame oil.
Add the cinnamon stick and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toss in the chicken thighs, searing them until browned on all sides.
Push the chicken aside and add onion, garlic, ginger, carrots, and bell pepper, stirring for 3 minutes.
Pour in the Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, and brown sugar, then cover the pot and let simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the toasted baguette slices, letting the bread absorb the sauce and thicken the mixture.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for an additional 10 minutes until the bread is fully incorporated and the sauce is dense.
Finish with a splash of sesame oil, season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot straight from the tagine pot.
